description: Get last-chance / vandaag-af / clearance items from an Albert Heijn store. Requires a store_id (use ah_search_stores to find stores, or provide postal_code to find the nearest store). Uses the dedicated bargainItems GraphQL endpoint which returns today-only markdown deals. When you mention a product or recipe from the result, link its name to its url.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 20)

postal_code.description: Dutch postal code (e.g. '1234AB') to find the nearest store when store_id is not known.

store_id.description: AH store ID. Required to retrieve bargain items.

name: ah_get_last_chance_items
title: Albert Heijn: Last-Chance Items
